correctness.rationale: For N(s,t)=max{|s|,|t|,|s−t|}, the unit ball has six vertices. At v=(1,1), active norming functionals are the two coordinates and BJ-orthogonal w have opposite-sign entries. By vertex transitivity reduce to w=(q,−1), q≥1. The exact level-set frame midpoint calculation gives m(v,w)=1+(q−1)/(2q²), maximized at q=2 with 9/8; the published 2D frame reduction then yields DW=9/4. Independently check the attainment pair x=(−1,−2), y=(−1,0): N(x)=2, N(y)=1, N(x−y)=2, N(x/Nx−y/Ny)=3/2, giving 9/4. These verify the arithmetic and boundary q→∞, subject to the published frame theorem, not originality.
residual_risks: The frame formula is an external theorem; the new proof does not claim a general parameterized-hexagon formula.
